senses.gloss: (v. מוּק) to beat, stamp; trnsf. to scorn. Part. מָעֵיק, f. מְעִיקָא.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 19:21">Targ. II Kings XIX, 21</cite>; <cite ref="Isaiah 37:22">Is. XXXVII, 22</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00578"><he>מוּק</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:15">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> top <he>למחר … ואינון מְעִיקִין לן</he> to-morrow they will be with us (the dead), and now they scorn us (by treading on our graves).
